problems.original_quote: is a well-known obstacle to identification in this literature.
problems.revised_quote: is a well-known obstacle to identification in this literature: higher-quality products tend to receive more favorable reviews and also to sell more, so the observed relationship between valence and sales cannot be read as causal.
problems.explanation: The revision adds a causal mechanism and names sales as the outcome, neither of which the original states.

problems.original_quote: we estimate the effect and find it to be positive and significant
problems.revised_quote: we estimate the effect of review valence on sales and find it to be positive and significant
problems.explanation: The original never specifies the treatment or the outcome, so the revision asserts that the estimated effect is valence on sales.

problems.original_quote: which generates quasi-random assignment conditional on observed covariates
problems.revised_quote: which generates quasi-random assignment of cohorts to differing moderation exposure, conditional on observed covariates
problems.explanation: The revision specifies what is quasi-randomly assigned (cohorts to moderation exposure), a detail of the design the original leaves unstated.

parsed.summary: The revision adds a mechanism for endogeneity, names sales as the outcome variable, and specifies the unit and treatment of the quasi-random assignment. The original asserts none of these, so the meaning changed even though the additions are plausible.
